title: A multifunctional zeolite film enables stable high-voltage operation of a LiCoO2 cathode
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04370G, Paper
Zezhou Lin, Yiran Ying, Zhihang Xu, Gao Chen, Xi Gong, Zehua Wang, Daqin Guan, Leqi Zhao, Mingyang Yang, Ke Fan, Tiancheng Liu, Hao Li, Honglei Zhang, Huangxu Li, Xi Zhang, Ye Zhu, Zhouguang Lu, Zongping Shao, Peiyu Hou, Haitao Huang
This work proposes a multifunctional AlPO4-5 zeolite coating with a unique porous structure for developing a high-voltage LiCoO2 cathode.
